comment: Which files may hang off an inbox item, and as what.
Read by src/lib/inbox/inboxMedia.ts and, via include_str!, by
src-tauri/src/inbox.rs. One list on purpose: the picker and the drop
target decide what the user may offer, the backend decides what it
accepts, and a disagreement between them is a file the user can select
and then watch bounce with an error that names no reason they can see.
Text is plain text only — an attachment is inlined into the agent prompt
verbatim, so a format that needs decoding first would arrive as noise.
